messages:
marco: Alert from cortex: elevated 5xx rates on /v1/embeddings in hosted-us-west cluster. Customer impact: embeddings latency errors for ~6% of requests.
sasha: I'm seeing correlation with a config push to memcache eviction policy earlier today.
dina: Can we route calls to the fallback cache and reduce the eviction aggressiveness? I'll prepare a hotfix.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-5488 created and assigned to infra-oncall. https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-5488
marco: Temporarily disabled memcache eviction via feature flag: feature_toggle.disable_memcache_eviction=true
sasha: Rolling config change: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/flags -d '{"flag":"disable_memcache_eviction","env":"prod","value":true}'``` 
dina: Increased memcache replica count from 2 -> 4 in us-west to absorb load. kubectl patch statefulset memcache -n infra --patch "{'spec':{'replicas':4}}"
deploy-bot: memcache replicas scaled to 4 in us-west
status-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwoodinference.com/incidents/PD-5488 - "Embeddings degraded in US-WEST, mitigation in progress"
marco: 5xxs down to ~0.8%. Still seeing occasional spikes tied to a specific customer workload (heavy batched requests).
sasha: Throttled the offending client via per-customer qps limit; notified CS to contact them.
dina: Action items: 1) revert eviction policy change in next safe deploy 2) add memcache circuit-breaker so eviction OOMs don't surface as 5xxs 3) add per-customer throttles in routing layer
marco: Tickets opened: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7921 , https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7922 , https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7923
sasha: Incident set to monitoring. Will follow up with postmortem draft and timeline.
oncall-bot: Incident PD-5488 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring
marco: Thanks team. I'll close once postmortem published.
